shortDescription: Library mod: gives any pawn randomly rolled, hidden-until-discovered titan traits and materials, with naming, inheritance, visuals, light, ability AI and player settings. Content mods define the traits.
body:
## Purpose
Library mod for a later dungeon mod. Gives any pawn (animal, humanlike, mech) a set of rolled traits and a material. Content mods define the traits; this mod handles storage, rolling, discovery, naming, inheritance, visuals, light, materials and ability AI.

## Status
- Phase 1 (tested): traits, titan hediff, rolling, discovery, naming, inheritance, debug actions.
- Visuals (tested): overlays, effecters (Flaming = tint + embers + light).
- Phase 2 materials (tested run #28).
- Light (tested run #29; default follow 1 cell).
- Mod settings (tested run #30 as columns; build 29 switched to tabs, not yet seen in game). User preference: settings pages use tabs (lore saved).
- Phase 3 step 1, ability AI: tested run #31 (manhunter casts, discovery works). Tamed firebreather holding fire next to colonists is vanilla FireSpew's friendly-in-cone rule, by design.
- **Lead-in discovery (builds 36–38, reviewed, not yet tested):** trait revealed when an ability's visible lead-in effect starts.
- Phase 3 remaining: hide hidden traits in UI (stat explanations, ability gizmos), Biotech humanlike birth inheritance, diet traits, optional VRE gene compat.

## Ability AI (JobGiver_TitanAbilities, Source/TitanAI.cs)
- Postfix on Pawn_JobTracker.DetermineNextConstantThinkTreeJob: when the constant tree gave no job and the pawn is a titan, run our job giver (every 30 ticks, can interrupt the current job). Result recorded against the constant tree root so saved mid-cast jobs load cleanly. try/catch with ErrorOnce.
- Races with no constant think tree get no ability AI (e.g. mechs without Biotech).
- Guards: spawned, awake, not downed/burning/drafted, not a player colonist, not in a non-aggro mental state, not already casting, not full-body busy. Setting `abilityAI` turns it off.
- Order: 1) each trait's `aiThinkTree`; 2) combat only: offensive trait abilities at the current enemy (vanilla GetAbilityJob style, own-cell gate); 3) combat only: self-targeted non-offensive trait abilities.
- All casts go through vanilla AICanTargetNow (aiCanUse, cooldown, comp checks, e.g. FireSpew refuses when its own faction is in the cone; wild animals have no faction).

## Discovery of ability traits
- Normal path: Hediff_Titan.Notify_PawnUsedVerb when the ability resolves.
- Lead-in path: prefix+postfix on Ability.Notify_StartedCasting wraps this cast's new preCastActions (private list, FieldRefAccess) so the trait is revealed on the tick the visible effect starts. Needed because FireSpew plays its flames 17 ticks before resolving and vanilla cancels the cast if the target becomes invalid in that window. Only wraps when an undiscovered trait grants the ability.
- Known gap: world-target abilities cast from a caravan skip the verb path, so they don't reveal.

## Mod settings (TitanSettings, `TitanFrameworkMod.Settings`)
Tabs: Lights and effects / Traits / Materials, reset button bottom right.
- Lights and effects: lightsEnabled, lightFollowCells 1–5 (1), lightRadiusFactor 25–200%, effectsEnabled.
- Traits: inheritChanceFactor 0–200%, discoveryMessages, abilityAI.
- Materials: materialArmorFactor 0–150% (50%), materialDamageStrength 0–200%, fireWeaknessStrength 0–200%, butcherYieldPerBodySize 0–200 (40), smallVolumeMultiplier 1–20 (10), materialMarketValue.
- On window close every titan gets SettingsChanged().

## TitanTraitDef (XML: `<TitanFramework.TitanTraitDef>`)
- Generation: commonality, pointCost, exclusionTags, tags, race filters (allowAnimals/Humanlikes/Mechanoids/Other, requiresFlesh, disallowConstructs, min/maxBodySize, allowedRaces, disallowedRaces).
- Discovery: visible, discoverWhen (Manual, UsesGrantedVerb, UsesGrantedAbility, Attacks, TakesDamage, Dies), discoveryMessage.
- Naming: namePrefix, nameSuffix, nameOrder.
- Inheritance: heritable, inheritChance (× setting).
- Effects: stage, hediffs, abilities, aiThinkTree, traitClass.
- Visuals: overlays, flames, effecters, scaleEffectersWithBodySize, showVisualsWhenHidden, glow.

## Visuals, light, materials
- Overlays, flames, effecters (MapComponent, zero-offset Trigger). Light via unlisted CompGlower, largest radius wins.
- Materials: stuff on Hediff_Titan, statue look, stats from stuff (scaled by settings), construct body, butchering yields stuff, market value StatPart, TitanMaterialExtension (granted traits, tags, factors).

## Harmony patches (14)
BestKindLabel postfix; DoBirthSpawn and CompHatcher.Hatch prefix/finalizer; TrySpawnHatchedOrBornPawn prefix; DropBloodFilth/DropBloodSmear prefixes; MakeCorpse postfix; Corpse.IngestibleNow postfix; Pawn.ButcherProducts postfix; Pawn_JobTracker.DetermineNextConstantThinkTreeJob postfix; Ability.Notify_StartedCasting prefix + postfix.

## Known limitations
- Info card shows hidden traits' numbers; hidden traits' abilities may show gizmos (Phase 3 step 2).
- Humanlike births don't inherit yet.
- Debug palette pins for our actions fail; don't pin them.

## Debug actions ("Titan Framework")
Add trait…, Roll traits…, Set material…, Discover all traits, Clear titan.

## Example content (Defs/Examples + Patches/TF_ExampleMaterials.xml): remove both together before publishing
Flaming, Venomous, Ironhide, Of the Deep, Brittle, Irradiated (Uranium), Firebreather (Biotech; hidden; TF_Example_FireBreath, fire spew copy, 1-hour cooldown).
